Company description: ABT (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

Abbott Laboratories (ABT) is a global healthcare leader dedicated to improving life through the development of science-based technologies. Founded in 1888 by Dr. Wallace C. Abbott, the company has evolved from a small drug manufacturer into a diversified powerhouse with a presence in over 160 countries. Abbott operates through four primary business segments: diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic pharmaceuticals. Its portfolio includes market-leading innovations such as the FreeStyle Libre glucose monitoring system, cardiovascular devices, and a wide array of diagnostic testing platforms. By focusing on the intersection of technology and healthcare, Abbott provides essential products that help people manage chronic conditions and maintain overall health. Headquartered in Abbott Park, Illinois, the company remains committed to advancing medical science to address some of the world’s most pressing health challenges.
